E_NOT_OK : the copy could not be performed. Description The Rte_GetMirror API copies the values of the VariableDataPrototypes contained in a NvBlock Descriptor to a specified NVM internal buffer. In the prototype, <b> is the SwComponentPrototype ’s name of the NvBlockSwComponentType and <d> is the NvBlockDescriptor name. Available via Rte_<NvBlockSwComponentType>.h
